title: Senior Research Technician, In Vivo
summary: Contribute across the full lifecycle of contracted studies: execute client projects, perform in vivo procedures and support in vitro work alongside our scientists.
requirements:
Experience at a contract research organization
Strong in vivo technical skills
Self-motivated, organized and detail oriented

title: Scientist, In Vivo Study Director
summary: Lead contract research projects from start to finish: coordinate and manage studies, ensure effective execution, and interpret and report study data to clients.
requirements:
Experience at a contract research organization
Study design, data interpretation and reporting experience
Self-motivated, with clear client communication

title: Research Associate, In Vivo
summary: Perform in vivo animal procedures, some in vitro laboratory work and facility operations, under the direct supervision of our study team.
requirements:
CRO or other relevant animal research experience
Willingness to learn new techniques
Self-motivated and dependable

title: Research Associate, In Vitro
summary: Perform in vitro laboratory procedures and support facility operations, under the supervision of our in vitro lead.
requirements:
CRO or other relevant laboratory experience
Familiarity with assays such as ELISA, flow cytometry or cell culture
Self-motivated and detail oriented
